examples.name: Sample — tabs, tiles and labelled photos
paragraphs: Three tabs top-left, the third filled red; a slide title and subtitle; four bullets and a stat-tile panel in the left card; two photographs, grey silhouettes each with a boxed name label at the lower right; a footnote; a footer with the slide number, deck name and a wordmark with a small symbol. The tabs are one furniture block in printed order, the active one highlighted; each photo becomes a one-line description carrying its label.

examples.name: Sample — a map behind the text
paragraphs: A pale, wavy background shape fills the right-hand card behind two headings and six bullets. It prints no text, no values and no labels, so it yields no Markdown. The left card is a stat tile over a small table — see Stat Tiles§5.11.
